rules.message: Avoid long-running `pgrep -f` polling loops that time out; instead check once, use a bounded retry loop with short sleeps, or wait on the process directly. Worked before: `for i in $(seq 1 60); do pgrep -f '[b]uild.py' >/dev/null || break; sleep 5; done`
Avoid force-pushing main; use a normal push or open a pull request instead.

This shell is zsh: an unquoted word starting with `=` (`===`, `[ a == b ]`) is expanded as a command path and fails — quote it or use `[[ … ]]` (failed 3× (zsh-equals) across 2 sessions). Worked before: `make build && echo "=== Build done ==="`
`timeout` is not installed on this machine (failed 3× (missing-command) across 2 sessions). Worked before: `perl -e 'alarm 60; exec @ARGV' npm test`
